notes.title: FRAMED Collection gets a release date!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31028674/a7021093b31a4a891e6e91ca355efff5a4d6aad7.jpg

Hi there, and welcome to our FRAMED Collection community!

We’re very happy to finally announce the release date of May 17 for FRAMED Collection on Steam (PC, Mac and Linux versions). If you love clever, unique puzzle games, spy adventures, noir aesthetics and jazz fusion soundtracks, then be sure to wishlist the game! If you do that, we’ll also be able to let you know about any great ‘launch week’ deals.

Of course, once the game has released, we’d love to hear what you think of it. Be sure to come back and post your thoughts, GIFs, questions and user reviews in the Community Hub; we love hearing from our fans. If you’re on Twitter, come and say, ‘Hey,’ by tweeting @loveshackers.

We’ll post again soon, around the launch of the game. Until then, thanks for checking out FRAMED Collection.

- Loveshack Devs
